verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE feature lets users query logs/metrics via natural language and get AI-generated suggestions like automated post-mortems, PR fix suggestions, and Linear ticket suggestions based on incident data. This directly matches the story of getting AI-generated insights from data inside the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and detail on how deeply these suggestions integrate beyond incident/SRE use cases (e.g., broader analytics insights).
